description: Header file defining the AppGatewayImplementation class, which implements interfaces for app gateway resolution and configuration within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal class RespondJob.

classes.name: AppGatewayImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing app gateway resolution and configuration interfaces, managing communication with app gateway components, and handling events and messaging.

classes.name: RespondJob
classes.description: Internal class for dispatching responses asynchronously, either returning messages via socket or launching delegates based on context.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the app gateway resolver with provided paths.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request based on context, origin, method, and parameters, producing a result.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the service shell.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming events with context, alias, event name, origin, and listen flag.

methods.name: ReturnMessageInSocket
methods.description: Sends a message payload back through the socket if responder is available.

methods.name: SendToLaunchDelegate
methods.description: Sends payload to launch delegate for processing.

methods.name: ReadCountryFromConfigFile
methods.description: Reads country information from configuration file.
